title: Enabling prefer_native_menu on a root PopupMenu causes editor crash on Windows
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.4.beta3.official [06acfccf8] and later versions.
- Not reproducible in: v4.4.beta2.official [a013481b0] and earlier versions.

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21043.5001) - AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.14 GiB memory

### Issue description

Enabling "Prefer Native Menu" on a PopupMenu node that is the root node of a scene causes the editor to crash whenever that scene is loaded.

Crash was not reproducible when tested on Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS so I assume it is Windows specific.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new scene with a PopupMenu as the root node.
2. Enable "Prefer Native Menu" in PopupMenu's inspector.
3. Save and reload scene.
